info.title: Shopify & WooCommerce Product Catalog Normalizer (Apify Cloud API)
info.description:
Ingests dirty multi-vendor CSV/JSON supplier feeds and transforms unescaped quotes, delimiters, variant matrices, and ISO-4217 currencies into clean Shopify RFC 4180 feeds.

RapidAPI Cloud Integration powered by Apify Pay-Per-Event (PPE).
Unit Execution Price: $0.050 USD.

post.summary: Synchronously execute catalog-feed-normalizer and retrieve output dataset items
post.description: Starts the Actor, waits for execution to complete, and directly returns the output dataset records as a JSON array. Recommended for RapidAPI integrations.

csvUrl.title: CSV Download URL

mapping.title: Column Mapping JSON
mapping.description: Custom mapping dictionary from vendor CSV columns to Shopify fields (title, price, sku, etc.). Leave empty for automatic column detection.
